<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
* Prefetch bottle attestations in bulk by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24436
* Correct documentation and JSON help by @hezhizhen in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24437
* Fix shared documentation lint edge cases by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24443
* Explain denied Landlock root directory listings by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24448
* Require `zap` stanzas in all official casks by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24435
* Verify backfilled :all bottle subjects by @hezhizhen in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24447
* Harden MCP server schemas and argument handling by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24453
* livecheck: make throttle rate and days mutually exclusive by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24451
* Add explicit package source loading APIs by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24438
* create: Audit fix - skip version if it is present in URL by @abitrolly in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24385
* Skip `id` forks for read-only brew commands by @bvolpato in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24455
* workflows/tests: audit homebrew/cask on Linux by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24434
* Migrate formula callers to explicit source APIs by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24439
* Migrate cask callers to explicit source APIs by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24441
* Explain root command and service ownership trust by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24457
* ISSUE_TEMPLATE.md: remove retired template by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24459
* Document and update the Security Team by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24461
* Read curl headers from stdin with curl 7.55+ by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24464
* info: mark formulae removed from their tap by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24462
* Allow updating PyPI resources when bumping non-PyPI formula by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24463
* Measure maintainer access used to help others by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24456
* Make sponsor ordering deterministic by @ZhongRuoyu in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24468
* doctor: skip removed formulae in unlinked check by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24466
* bundle: add a `pin: true` Brewfile option by @zhuoqun-chen in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24454
* cleanup: remove old kegs of outdated formulae by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24465
* docs: Add ToC to Language Specific Formulae by @abitrolly in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24473
* vendor-gems: limit dispatches to brew branches by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24478
* Expand language-specific formula guidance by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24479
* Audit GoReleaser flags in staged resources by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24481
* rubocops/components_redundancy: drop bottle audit by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24487
* Apply the command name check to external lookups by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24483
* livecheck/strategy/crate: use sparse index by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24449
* Allow untapping untrusted formula taps by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24477
* unpack: verify cached cask checksums by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24480
* diagnostic: fix spacing around warnings by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24485
* Validate MCP help topics before dispatch by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24484
* bundle: upgrade remaining package types by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24445
* update-report: warn about branches after report by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24486
* Remove test and cop references to unsupported `branch` stanza by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24489
* deprecate_disable: omit past estimated dates by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24491
* pr-pull: remove stale `merge-base` TODO by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24492
* dev-cmd/tests: find changed tests when split inside directory by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24494
* autoremove: remove unused source-built formulae by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24471
* rubocops/uses_from_macos: remove php, add corrections by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24495
* Upgrade fewer dependencies when building from source by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24503
* rubocops/lines: remove cop for unsupported special dependencies by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24498
* generate-cask-ci-matrix: skip homepage age audit by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24505
* doctor: skip removed formulae in deprecated check by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24490
* workflows: create issue with bug type by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24508
* Add Markdown summaries to maintainer reports by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24497
* cask/upgrade: fail on named casks that cannot be upgraded by @carlocab in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24512
* rubocops/lines: move rustup check outside strict by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24510
* info: show dependents recorded under other names by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24516
* formula_installer: keep unlinked kegs unlinked by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24514
* Ignore invalid legacy bottle digests by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24515
* dev-cmd/bump: apply cooldown to days throttled formulae by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24450
* cask/dsl: store lone intel and x86_64 sha256 by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24517
* rubocops: remove outdated text cops, move test files for lines cops by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24524
* rubocops/on_system: remove stale TODO by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24526
* formulary: find racks under aliases and old names by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24527
* Type `brew audit` options instead of `**options` by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24523
* bundle: honour qualified formula and cask taps by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24528
* Remove handling of googlecode.com and gitorious.org urls by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24533
* docs: change AI attribution context by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24534
* uninstall: add a dry-run option by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24530
* bundle: fix verbose npm execution by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24537
* fetch: silence missing hook dependency warnings by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24538
* Preserve dependency status in recovery advice by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24540
* Skip disabled packages in outdated reports by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24539
* Type `readall` options instead of `**options` by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24541
* Type cask audit options instead of `**options` by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24542
* Type `livecheck` options instead of `**options` by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24543

## New Contributors
* @bvolpato made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24455
* @zhuoqun-chen made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24454

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/compare/7.0.12...7.0.13
